description: Weekly update PR for the homelab compose images, run by .github/workflows/renovate.yaml (its cron is the schedule — no `schedule` here, so a manual dispatch also opens PRs). Nix inputs are handled by update-flake-lock, so only docker-compose is enabled. Merging does not deploy — run `just deploy` afterwards.

packageRules.description: One PR per week for everything non-major, so there is a single item to review.
Major versions can carry migrations for stateful services; wait until ticked on the Dependency Dashboard.
linuxserver tags are v<app>-ls<build>; treat the ls build number as part of the version.
